name: Weapon Wheel Pause
author: glawks
description: Pause RAC1 during Quick Select while preserving water, scenery and visual effects, with animation freezing and configurable background shading.

settings.name: Freeze enemy animations
settings.description: Set the game's animation-skip bit on mobys whose gameplay update is paused.

settings.name: Keep water and scenery drawing
settings.description: Let known visual-effect controllers run each frame to draw water, mud, ship glass and other scenery effects.

settings.name: Freeze Hoven water scrolling
settings.description: Temporarily stop the game frame clock during Hoven's class 1901 update so the surface stays visible but its scrolling texture stays still.

settings.name: Log pause diagnostics
settings.description: When the weapon wheel closes, log the observed moby classes and which ones were exempted, for investigating missing scenery.

settings.name: Soften background during weapon selection
settings.description: Shade the scene beneath the weapon wheel. API 1.12 uses RAC1's own tint renderer; API 1.14+ builds can use a feathered overlay. This is not a Gaussian blur.

settings.name: Background softening strength
settings.description: Strength of the translucent shade in percent. Changes take effect after restarting the game.
